context.body: Then David the king went in and sat before the LORD; and he said, “Who am I, Lord GOD, and what is my house, that you have brought me this far.

observations.body: David asks who he and his house are, speaks of God’s greatness and Israel’s redemption, and asks that the spoken word and house be established.
